empty.title: Add your first application
empty.body: Your applications will appear here, in a simple list.

footer.privacy: Your data stays in this browser.

notSaved.title: Changes can't be saved in this browser
notSaved.body: Your data is only kept while this tab is open. Export a backup to keep a copy.

unreadable.title: Some saved data couldn't be read
unreadable.bodyKept: We kept a copy of it. You can download it, or clear it if you don't need it.
unreadable.bodyOlderCopy: An earlier unreadable copy is already stored, so the newer data is left untouched. Download or clear the earlier copy to continue.
unreadable.bodyNoCopy: We couldn't keep a copy of it, and it has been left untouched. Your changes are only kept until you close this tab.

saveFailed.title: Your latest change couldn't be saved
saveFailed.bodyQuota: This browser's storage is full. Export a backup so nothing is lost.
saveFailed.bodyUnknown: Something stopped the browser from saving. Export a backup so nothing is lost.

backupDue.title: Time for a backup?
backupDue.body: Export a copy of your data so it is safe.

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.label: Days before a "no reply" reminder
reminder.error: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

backup.title: Backup
backup.neverExported: You haven't exported a backup yet.

import.label: Import a backup
import.hint: Choose a .json file exported from this app.

delete.title: Delete all my data
delete.body: Removes all applications and settings from this browser. This can't be undone.
delete.done: All your data has been deleted.
delete.failed: Your data couldn't be deleted. Try again, or clear this site's data in your browser settings.

replace.title: Replace your current data?
replace.body: Importing this backup replaces the data currently saved in this browser.

delete.title: Delete all your data?
delete.body: Everything saved in this browser will be removed. Export a backup first if you might want it back.

importErrors.unreadable: The file isn't a readable backup.
importErrors.unsupported_version: This backup has version {found}, but this app reads version {supported}.
importErrors.invalid_value: {path}: this value isn't allowed. Allowed values: {allowed}.
importErrors.duplicate_id: {path}: the id “{id}” is used more than once.
importErrors.unknown_cv: {path}: refers to a CV that isn't in the backup (“{cvId}”).
importErrors.closed_reason_mismatch: {path}: the closing reason doesn't match the status “{status}”.
importErrors.out_of_range: {path}: must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
importErrors.too_large: The file is larger than {maxMb} MB.
